description: This file contains unit tests for the EmployeeLatestAttendanceRecordAPI class within the OrangeHRM Attendance plugin. It tests API endpoints related to employee attendance records, including 'getOne' functionality and checks for unimplemented methods like 'update', 'delete', and validation rule retrieval.
